info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Disputes-v5-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Disputes API is designed to provide users with a comprehensive view of utility billing disputes. This endpoint allows developers to retrieve a list of ongoing disputes, including relevant details and statuses. Typical consumers include customer service representatives, auditors, and analytics teams who need to assess billing issues and manage customer interactions effectively. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their billing dispute resolution processes and improve customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of a specific billing dispute. It provides necessary information related to the dispute, including the status and any relevant data tied to it.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a dispute regarding a billing issue. It must contain the necessary information to identify the transaction and the reasons for disputing the charge.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: Schema representing a request body in JSON format for getting billing dispute operations.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_201.title: Billing Dispute Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the dispute.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message detailing the result of the operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit trail for the dispute.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_201.description: Schema representing the response received from the billing dispute operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the audit details of the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value is helpful for performance monitoring and optimization.
